text: {"name":"ble_scan_process_reports","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes the BLE advertising-report queue for a scan context, advances the scan-channel list, issues HCI scan control commands, and stops or disables scanning when all reports/channels have been handled.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"scan_ctx","a2":"initialize","v3":"entry","v4":"entry_end","v8":"report_pool","v9":"entry","v10":"entry_end","v11":"entry","v12":"channel_count","v13":"next_channel_idx","v14":"channel_idx","v15":"channel_count","v16":"chan_info","v17":"chan_info","v18":"event_buf","v19":"adv_len"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":40,"meaning":"scan_ctx: start timestamp/saved state recorded when scan is initialized"},{"offset":58,"meaning":"scan_ctx: length of advertising payload copied into the report/event buffer"},{"offset":59,"meaning":"scan_ctx: advertising payload bytes used when constructing a scan report/event"},{"offset":92,"meaning":"scan_ctx: scan pending/IRQ flag cleared on completion if controller is ready"},{"offset":96,"meaning":"scan_ctx: current scan channel index or processed report counter"},{"offset":100,"meaning":"scan_ctx: scan channel/frequency parameter used for report generation"},{"offset":101,"meaning":"scan_ctx: total number of scan channels or scan rounds to process"},{"offset":102,"meaning":"scan_ctx: channel list indexed by the counter at +96"}]}
